🌱 Agriculture Agriculture is the first development phase of AgroVenture. In this section, landowners, farmers, and agri-merchants can work together through one offline Android app. Agriculture Features
• Landowners can hire farmers
 • Farmers can view and apply for jobs
 • Farmers can rent agricultural equipment
 • Agri-Merchants can manage tractor and equipment rental
 • Irrigation service management
 • Cultivation service management
 • Harvesting service management
 • Ratings and feedback system
 • Admin can verify users
 • Admin can approve or reject services
 • Offline SQLite-based local storage
🚜 Rural Transport Rural Transport will help village people request local transport services for goods, crops, farming tools, and daily movement. Possible Transport Features
• Crop transport request
 • Local vehicle booking
 • Tractor or van availability
 • Goods delivery inside village
 • Transport provider profile
 • Service request tracking
 • Ratings and feedback
🏡 Cottage Services Cottage Services will create employment opportunities for different types of village people. Anyone with a skill can provide services, and general users can take those services. Possible Cottage Service Features
• Small industry service listing
 • Nokshi Kantha service
 • Handmade craft service
 • Tailoring service
 • Food processing service
 • Skilled worker profile
 • Customer service request
 • Local earning opportunity
 • Ratings and feedback
🏢 Village Booth Service Each village can have a booth service to help users who cannot use the app properly. Booth operators can assist farmers, landowners, service providers, and general users. Booth Service Features
• Help users create accounts
 • Help farmers apply for jobs
 • Help landowners request services
 • Help agri-merchants manage listings
 • Provide app support for village people
 • Collect local service requests
 • Support offline users
A smart village service platform for agriculture, rural transport, cottage services, and booth support. Contact us Email: support@villageconnect.com Phone: +880 1234 567890 Head Office: Bashundhara R/A, Dhaka, Bangladesh © 2026 Village Connect. All rights reserved.
